component.name: TaskTest
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runTask" ' Mirrors what a transpiled BrighterScript class instance looks like in `m`: a plain AA ' that cached the global/top nodes in its fields during construction. `m.global` and ' `m.top` are serialized before it, so its copies of them cross as circular references. m.helper = { global: GetGlobalAA().global, top: m.top } end sub
sub runTask() print "HELPER GLOBAL TYPE: "; type(m.helper.global) print "HELPER TOP TYPE: "; type(m.helper.top) print "HELPER GLOBAL VERSION: "; m.helper.global.server.version print "HELPER TOP LABEL: "; m.helper.top.label m.top.result = "ok" end sub
